senses.gloss:
Kaṁsa
------------------------------------------
Supposed to be the son of the king Ugrasena of मथुरा, कṁस was actually the son of the demon Kālanemi (or Drumila) from Ugrasena’s queen whom he cleverly cheated by assuming the form of Ugrasena using his magical powers.
Kaṁsa was a tyrant from the beginning. As he grew up, he usurped the kingdom by dethroning Ugrasena and imprisoning him. When देवकी, his younger sister was married to Vasudeva and when कṁस was taking them for a ride in his chariot, he heard a voice from the void that the eighth issue of देवकी would cause his death. कṁस, frightened by this, tried to kill देवकी. But he was pacified by Vasudeva who promised to hand over all the children born to देवकी. Though कṁस spared her life, he imprisoned her and Vasudeva and also killed all the six babies born to them. The seventh was miraculously transferred to the womb of रोहिणी, the elder wife of Vasudeva, living in गोकुल. The eighth was कृष्ण, the इन्चर्नतिओन् of Lord विष्णु. कṁस tried his best to get him killed but was himself killed by him later.
See also KṚṢṆA.
